about_the_game:
Slug Poker!

The Lucky Hive is a poker game about playing with your friends and having fun.

Poker is a fun and very social game. The Lucky Hive is about having fun, playing poker with your friends and enjoy the game. It's not about chasing that insane high of trying to win millions of dollars or hook you into some positive EV, hands per hour cycle that sucks your life away.

A lot of poker games are loaded with microtransactions, designed to capitalise on addicts and hook people in with flashy lights, casino aesthetics and delusions of wealth and success. They often throw the fun that is playing Poker out the window and treat it like some game that is solely about making money. The Lucky Hive fully rejects that and celebrates the game of poker with absolutely zero focus on gambling.

So if you want to play a game with your friends that might live far away or you want to have a fun night at home, The Lucky hive is a great way to enjoy yourself and have some fun playing cards.

Multiplayer

The game can support up to 6 people in a lobby and is peer-to-peer, so no need to worry about servers or on-going server support. 

You can also play against AI characters (up to 5 others) if you want to fill up the table or simply play some single-player poker.

Voice Support

The Lucky Hive has voice support so you can speak in-game, or use text chat to discuss if you prefer that.

Cosmetics

In The Lucky Hive, you can customise your character based on things that have happened in the game (such as winning with a bluff, getting a royal flush, four of a kind etc.) and showcase your character's bling when playing!
